name: Beijing Watertek Information Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Watertek Information Technology Co., Ltd. operates in the software and information technology service industry in China and internationally. The company offers industry digitization products, including data collection and conversion, data transmission, control and execution, urban static traffic, and independent terminal products; embedded system testing; industry data intelligence products, such as equipment support, high-speed data processing, cloud services and platform, digital twin, and intelligent equipment.
